status.description: pending (actionable) or active (read-only context) -- rejected images never appear here

ocr_text.description: Tier B's primary review signal; null if OCR hasn't run for this image yet (e.g. Tier A, before the OCR pre-pass)

text_heavy.description: True if the text-heavy classifier (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-15-text-heavy-classifier.md) marked this image text_heavy. False for both a not_text_heavy result and an image not yet classified -- the review UI only surfaces the positive signal.
